component_definition: ROS application trust boundary, distinct from C++ class or WIT Component Model

current_example.ROS_rights: Current bounded joint capability describe/read_state/submit/wait/close within this one principal
current_example.static_pointer_algorithm: Private source buffers remain within the originating single instance; not cross-private pointers.

enforcement_dependencies.SDK01: Frozen versioned component/channel/grant ABI and real guest wrappers/Xmake entry. This design defines no competing common ABI.
enforcement_dependencies.VM owner: Actual instance principal, memory backing graph, bound copy channel capability/generation/offset/length, per-caller permissions/audit, callback owner and revocation/update/cache safety.

mandatory_independent_case.scope: Separate component-memory qualification; not a prerequisite for the first CPU/headless permission/communication/stale/disconnect route

required_negative_groups: same-offset private sentinels and growth isolation
intentional aliases versus distinct memory and forbidden private imports/exports
forged or replayed channel capability/generation, mutation races and backpressure
identical Wasm bytes with different instance grants, stolen handles and confused deputy
real ROS denial without effect and fresh sensor/result feedback in guest

actuator.grants: Only bounded action write/result and explicit incoming command channel. No permission union.

target_graph.first_slice: At least two real separate instances, allowed typed transfer, one independent denied operation, real ROS input/result through Wasm; then three instances.
target_graph.new_module_version_required: Splitting current monolithic C0 creates new version/hashes. Freeze every resulting module and graph for cross-vendor reuse; never claim original C0 hash continuity.

perception.grants: Only actual sensor/topic receive and permitted copy channel. No action write.
perception.native_provider: Verified bounded model/sensor primitive only; no guest business delegation.

planner.grants: Only typed copy channels and narrowly scoped file access; no ROS action grant.
planner.static_library: Ordinary pointer algorithm is statically linked into planner trust domain.

three_modes.explicit_preload: Opt-in compatibility only, discouraged default; entire intentionally bound memory is visible and pointer/allocator/lifetime/ABI ownership must be qualified.
three_modes.isolated_default: Separate Wasm instances and private language heaps/stacks/globals; no peer imports private memories.
three_modes.static: Same instance, heap and effective authority; no independent sandbox claim.
